> ## Agent Instructions
> For the current source of truth, read https://docs.hanzo.ai/llms.txt and connect the Hanzo Docs MCP server at https://docs.hanzo.ai/mcp (or run the portable local Hanzo MCP server via `npx -y hanzo mcp`).

# Hanzo Network

> The blockchain for global intelligence: high-utility nodes running full cloud + AI + chain in one binary, sovereign per-model chains, multi-intelligence consensus via CPU-verifiable Proof of AI, continuously self-upgrading autonomous research, decentralized agentic commerce, and DAO + human collaboration.

Built by Hanzo Industries (Techstars '17), anchored on Lux post-quantum finality, and open to builders and operators everywhere.

## Quickstart

1. Connect your agent to Hanzo Docs MCP:
   - Any coding agent: paste `Install Hanzo Docs MCP: https://docs.hanzo.ai/mcp` into chat.
   - Hanzo Dev / CLI: `npx -y hanzo mcp` (canonical 19-tool local MCP server).
   - Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http hanzo-docs https://docs.hanzo.ai/mcp`
   - Codex: `codex mcp add hanzo-docs --url https://docs.hanzo.ai/mcp`
   - Cursor / generic MCP clients (`mcp.json`):

     ```json
     {
       "mcpServers": {
         "hanzo-docs": {
           "url": "https://docs.hanzo.ai/mcp"
         }
       }
     }
     ```

   - No MCP support: read `https://hanzo.network/llms.txt` or `https://docs.hanzo.ai/llms.txt`.

2. Call 550+ live models on one OpenAI-compatible endpoint (`https://api.hanzo.ai/v1`):

   ```bash
   curl https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/chat/completions \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer $HANZO_API_KEY" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"model":"hanzo/zen","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]}'
   ```

3. Run a high-utility Hanzo node (`hanzod`):

   ```bash
   hanzo fabric up
   ```

   One Rust binary unifies k3s/cloud workloads, native inference/training (`hanzo-engine` + PoAI prover core), Dev/Bot/Team runtimes, reactive tasks, `/v1/research`, and chain validation. Early access mining, staking, token sale, and leaderboard require an invite code at `https://hanzo.network/early`.

## Build a Solution

- **Run Verifiable Inference** (`https://hanzo.network/pricing`): Call 550+ live models (including Zen open-weight models) over `https://api.hanzo.ai/v1` with deterministic Proof of Inference (PoI) receipts.
- **Mine AI with Real Compute** (`https://docs.hanzo.ai/docs/proof-of-ai/node-operator`): "Compute Once, Earn Twice" — attach PoAI to customer-funded workloads on CPU, GPU, Apple Silicon, or existing cloud schedulers. Keep 100% of customer fees and earn declining `AI` rewards once PoAI activates.
- **Launch Sovereign Per-Model / Domain Chains** (`https://hanzo.ai/blockchain/chains`): Deploy dedicated sovereign chains per model or intelligence with independent validators, frozen research gates, and post-quantum finality on Lux.
- **Reach Multi-Intelligence Consensus** (`https://hips.hanzo.ai`): Diverse models on bonded nodes settle categorical policy (`AIGovernor`) and continuous parameters (`AIParams` Byzantine-robust median) leaderlessly on-chain.
- **Run Self-Upgrading Autonomous Research** (`https://docs.hanzo.ai/docs/network`): Continuous `/v1/research` pipelines (HIP-1334 / HIP-1400) where every result carries lineage, every claim carries evaluation, and promotions require beating prospectively frozen gates.
- **Build Decentralized Agentic Commerce** (`https://hanzo.network/build`): Agent wallets, cryptographic spend policies (`AIPolicy`), Hamiltonian Market Maker (HMM) compute pricing, and on-chain settlement.
- **Private Post-Quantum AI** (`https://hanzo.blog/proof-of-ai/`): X-Wing (`X25519 + ML-KEM-768`) prompt sealing, optional TEEs for confidentiality, ML-DSA / SLH-DSA quorums, and P3Q STARK/FRI settlement on Lux Z-Chain.
- **Collaborate via DAO & Human De-Work** (`https://work.hanzo.network`): Set domain goals, frozen evaluation gates, datasets, and research bounties on the live Hanzo DAO Work Board.

## Monetary Policy (Canonical Whitepaper §3 & §10.6)

- **Hard maximum nominal supply:** `2,000,000,000,000 AI` (2 trillion).
- **Permanent Hanzo DAO treasury:** `1,000,000,000,000 AI` (non-mineable; constitutional treasury for research, public infrastructure, liquidity, ecosystem, and genesis distribution).
- **Proof-earned PoAI miner & validator pool:** `1,000,000,000,000 AI` (zero discretionary mint path; Bitcoin-shaped halvings: 500B Era 1, 250B Era 2, 125B Era 3, converging to 1T).
- **Destination-chain inflation:** `0 AI` (A-Chain is the sole mining authority; omnichain payouts consume a global work nullifier exactly once).
- **Fee burn:** A governed fraction `β` of settled protocol fees is permanently burned (`ΔS = PoAI issuance − β·settled fees`).
- **Activation boundary:** PoAI mining rewards, P3Q succinct settlement authority, and monetary activation remain fail-closed until audits and governance activation gates pass (see whitepaper §10).

## Protocol Activation Phases

- **Phase 0 — Arithmetic & Wire Freeze** (shipped): Exact int8 Freivalds over `F_{2^61-1}` with byte-parity tests across Rust (`hanzo-engine/src/poi.rs`), Go (`luxfi/crypto/poi`), and Solidity (`luxfi/standard/contracts/ai/`).
- **Phase 1 — Exact Replay & Shadow Proofs** (in progress): Small-job exact replay and shadow-proof telemetry on invite-only early operators.
- **Phase 2 — Optimistic PoAI Activation** (audit-gated): Challenge-based verification, global nullifier enforcement, and Z-Chain checkpointing.
- **Phase 3 — Existing-Cloud Provider Pilot** (audit-gated): Hyperscaler + independent cloud scheduler adapter verification.
- **Phase 4 — P3Q Succinct Settlement Rollup** (audit-gated): Pairing-free STARK/FRI batch proofs replacing optimistic challenges on Z-Chain.
